GMF file format analysis

This is a binary version of the 3D Studio Max ASCII export format (.ase), 
plus additional information needed for the RA2 bot workshop (attachment points)

Online sources on the format:

- http://astronomy.swin.edu.au/~pbourke/geomformats/ase/
- http://nate.scuzzy.net/docs/ase/
- http://www.solosnake.fsnet.co.uk/main/ase.htm
- ASE loading code: http://www.demogl.com/files/demogl_utils_lib.zip
- Official SDK and other materials: http://sparks.discreet.com/downloads/

An actual text equivalent of a GMF file can be found in
Components/cannon_txt.gmf; there are several others as well in the Arenas area
too (search for *_txt.gmf)

To read: First 19 bytes is preamble. Type info I expect (starts with the magic
'GMI').

Then read each chunk (12 bytes intro, unpack('iii') for type numbers and
lenght). If not interesting, seek ahead to next section. Some sections have the
wrong length count, or no length count at all! Clearly, RA2 ignores these for
its purposes.

Type numbers: section identifier and a 2 or 4. What does the 2 and 4 mean? A
section always has a 2 or a 4, consistently across all files; you'll never see
the same section type with a 2 in one place and a 4 in another. Maybe 2 is
'container' while 4 means 'leaf node', although this doesn't quite fit with the
purpose of some nodes.
